pages.text: ORSA supply sites may hold partially charged Power Cells. Check useful cargo, accessible monitoring-station supplies, abandoned evacuation vehicles and surviving camp equipment crates.$(br2)Each salvaged cell holds 100–300 kJ of its 500 kJ capacity. The charge bar and tooltip show what remains.

Put a salvaged cell in a Cell Dock and use the Conduit Binder to link a lamp or machine. This works without a Geothermal Core.$(br2)A cell is finite: an isolated dock cannot recharge it. To recharge, put the cell in a Battery Bank on a network with spare generation. An empty cell remains useful; carry it home.$(br2)Existing looted caches stay looted. Search newly discovered ORSA sites for salvage.
